nukes.name: Bushehr ☢️
nukes.info: IAEA: strikes 250ft from operating reactor. Rosatom evacuated 200 staff 'minutes before plant was hit.' 1 security guard killed. Iran AEOI head Eslami called strikes 'blatant war crime' in letter to IAEA. Ceasefire halts further strikes but perimeter still hot. Reactor remains operational.

nukes.name: Natanz
nukes.info: MAIN enrichment plant 75% damaged in Operation Epic Fury. 6,000+ IR-1 centrifuges destroyed. Above-ground halls collapsed. R&D facility 95% destroyed. Some 60% HEU stockpile believed to be in Natanz tunnel complex (per Grossi). IAEA cannot verify since cameras turned off. Underground facility may have new IR-6 cascades hidden — Arms Control Center: undeclared deep facility may already be under construction near Natanz.

nukes.name: Isfahan
nukes.info: CRITICAL: IAEA Director Grossi (Mar 9): MAJORITY of Iran's 440.9 kg of 60% HEU is in deeply buried tunnel complex here. Bulletin of Atomic Scientists: possibly up to 540 kg moved here before June 2025 strikes — satellite imagery showed truck with 18 containers at south tunnel entrance. UCF conversion facility 90% destroyed above ground. New underground enrichment facility declared June 2025 — IAEA never inspected. DNI Tulsi Gabbard (Mar 19): US has 'high confidence' on HEU stockpile location. Hegseth: 'It's buried, and we're watching it.'

nukes.name: Fordow
nukes.info: Fordow Fuel Enrichment Plant (FFEP) — built into mountain near Qom. ONLY 30% damaged despite GBU-57 MOPs causing tunnel collapses. Core facility may be INTACT — 'this is the greatest proliferation risk' (MissileStrikes intel). Designed to survive bunker busters. IAEA last verified 432.3 kg of 60% HEU produced here since Nov 2022. Could host hidden IR-6 centrifuge cascades. From 60% HEU, single IR-6 cascade can produce weapon-grade material every 25 days.

nukes.name: Arak (Khondab)
nukes.info: Heavy-water reactor at Khondab 60% damaged in strikes. Plutonium pathway facility. IAEA monitoring. Reactor not yet operational at full capacity. Construction was set to complete 2025, operation 2026. May 2025 IAEA: 'no significant changes observed' — strikes have set back timeline significantly.

nukes.name: Yazd (Ardakan)
nukes.info: Yellowcake plant struck Apr 3 (IDF/Wikipedia). Early-stage uranium processing. Damage limits Iran's ability to produce new feedstock for years. Front end of fuel cycle now disrupted.

nukes.name: Parchin
nukes.info: Nuclear weapon component testing facility near Tehran. 50% damaged per intel. Historical site of suspected weaponization research (AMAD Project pre-2003). IAEA denied access for years. Hegseth Congressional testimony June 2025: Iran was 'attempting nuclear breakout.'

nukes.name: Dimona (Israel)
nukes.info: Iranian missiles hit Arad + Dimona near Israel's Negev nuclear center. 100+ injured. IAEA: no damage to facility. First time area targeted this war. Israel never declared its arsenal but estimated 80-90 warheads.

cities.info: 1,800km downwind from Iran. 440.9kg HEU stockpile at Isfahan/Fordow remains unaccounted. NO iodine prophylaxis program. If Hegseth's 'forced removal' triggers underground response, atmospheric vector active.

Closest Indian metro to Iran. Dual exposure vector. Jamnagar refinery uses Arabian Sea water.
Rajasthan wind funnel. Aramco smoke plumes 5-8 days.
Southern Naval Command. Oil spill risk 15-25 days.
Konkan coast. Fishing economy ₹4,000 cr exposed.
Indo-Gangetic plain trap. Inversion layers concentrate atmospheric particles.
IRIS Dena wreck 400km south. East coast currents provide buffer.

assessment.body:
The end of Day 42 brings a contradictory but slightly more hopeful picture than 12 hours ago.

LEBANON DE-ESCALATION TRACK GAINING
• Lebanese PM Nawaf Salam will travel to Washington in coming days (per CNN)
• State Department to host Israel-Lebanon talks next week
• Lebanese President Joseph Aoun: wants ceasefire FIRST, then direct negotiations
• Salam pledged to restrict weapons to 'legitimate forces only'
• Direct Israel-Lebanon negotiations would be HISTORIC — they have no diplomatic relations
• BUT: Lebanese official: 'no negotiations under fire'
• Israeli source: 'no ceasefire... talks held under fire'
• Israel-Hezbollah continued strikes Friday: Israel hit Hezbollah targets, Hezbollah fired on Israeli soldiers + Kiryat Shmona settlement
• Beirut death toll exceeded 300 (NBC News)
• Israel's defense minister: Hezbollah is 'pleading' for ceasefire after heavy strikes
• ICRC: 'outraged by attacks in densely populated urban areas'

IRAN ADVISER KHARAZI DIED
• Senior adviser to supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei died Thursday
• Injuries from earlier US-Israeli strike on his home
• 14th high-level Iranian death in 6 weeks of war
• New written statement attributed to Mojtaba Khamenei: 'will certainly punish the aggressors who targeted our country, we will definitely demand compensation', 'bring management of Strait of Hormuz into a NEW PHASE', 'decisive victory over enemy whether in field of negotiations or on battlefield'

HORMUZ — STILL 95% BLOCKED
• Per MarineTraffic analyzed by NBC News: ONLY 19 vessels have sailed through Strait of Hormuz since ceasefire began Tuesday evening
• Normal flow would be ~390 ships in 3 days — 95% reduction
• 4 were tankers (crude/chemicals), majority bulk carriers, 3 Iranian-flagged
• Hormuzstraitmonitor.com: 9 vessels in last 24 hours, 8 in transit Friday 3 AM local
• Lloyd's List: 600+ vessels stuck in Middle East Gulf region
• 'Even if traffic returned to pre-conflict levels tomorrow, would still take 10+ days to move all vessels out'
• Trump accused Iran of 'doing a very poor job' of opening Hormuz
• IRGC Navy posted on X: Hormuz 'entered a new phase' of management
• UK PM Starmer-Trump call discussed 'military capabilities' to get Hormuz shipping moving (per BBC)
• UAE Industry Min Sultan Al Jaber (Wed): 'Strait of Hormuz is NOT open. Access is being restricted, conditioned and controlled'

SAUDI PRODUCTION HIT HARD
• Saudi Arabia confirmed: oil production capacity reduced by ~600,000 bpd from facility attacks
• East-West Pipeline (Hormuz bypass) throughput cut by ~700,000 bpd
• Brent settled ~$96 Friday (down 12% on the week from $110+ pre-ceasefire)
• WTI ~$98, swung in $7 range Thursday
• Iran sustained 1.9 million bpd exports in March (OilPrice.com)
• Goldman Sachs: 'Brent will average more than $100/barrel through 2026 if Strait of Hormuz remains closed for another month'

INDIAN MARKETS — RELIEF RALLY FADED FAST
• FPI outflow ₹8,200 crore in just 2 days of US-Iran ceasefire (BusinessToday)
• Sensex Wed +2,946 to 77,562.90
• Sensex Thu fell 932 pts intraday to 76,629
• Nifty 23,760.45 (-236.90 / -0.99%)
• HDFC + ICICI Bank alone -250 pts on Sensex
• IndiGo -4% Thu (gave back Wed +10%)
• India VIX 20.26 (still elevated)
• TCS Q4 strong: net profit ₹13,750 cr (+12% YoY), final dividend ₹31/share
• FY26 total dividend ₹110/share
• Wipro to consider 6th buyback April 16
• Morgan Stanley: 95,000 Sensex target Dec 2026 retained, valuations at 'previous troughs'
• Jefferies: 'apocalypse postponed' but risk premium remains
• Nomura: 'binary risks, recommend balanced portfolios'
• Kotak: Q4 Nifty50 profit growth just 2.6% YoY expected

NUCLEAR — REFRESHED WITH VERIFIED DATA
Based on IAEA Feb 27, 2026 report and arms control analyses:
• Iran has 440.9 KG of 60% HEU (verified by IAEA before Feb 28 ceasefire of access)
• Could yield 9-10 nuclear weapons if processed to 90% (Grossi)
• PRIMARY storage: Isfahan underground tunnel complex — at least 200 kg (Bulletin of Atomic Scientists assessment: possibly up to 540 kg moved here pre-strikes)
• Some HEU also at Natanz tunnel complex (per Grossi)
• Possibly some at Fordow (per Grossi)
• IAEA 'lost continuity of knowledge' (May 2025) — IRREVERSIBLE
• Iran terminated ALL IAEA access February 28, 2026 — first day of war
• Damage assessment:
  - Natanz main enrichment plant: 75% damaged, 6,000+ centrifuges destroyed
  - Natanz R&D: 95% destroyed
  - Fordow deep bunker: ONLY 30% damaged — core facility may be INTACT
  - Isfahan conversion: 90% destroyed above-ground
  - Arak heavy water reactor: 60% damaged
  - Parchin: 50% damaged
• Fordow is 'the greatest proliferation risk' — could host hidden IR-6 cascades
• Single IR-6 cascade can enrich 60% → 90% in 10 days
• Hegseth (Apr 8 Pentagon): 'Iran will hand over voluntarily, or face forced removal. It's always been non-negotiable'
• Hegseth: 'It's buried, and we're watching it'
• AEOI head Eslami: any attempt to limit enrichment 'will fail'
• DNI Tulsi Gabbard (Mar 19): US has 'high confidence' on stockpile locations
• Iran's 10-point plan demands ENRICHMENT RIGHTS — non-starter for Trump
• This is the unresolved structural issue

SATURDAY MORNING ISLAMABAD TALKS
• VP Vance leading US team
• Steve Witkoff + Jared Kushner on team
• Iranian delegation arrived Thursday night
• Iran's Parliament speaker Ghalibaf (likely lead Iran negotiator): 'TIME IS RUNNING OUT'
• Lebanon and 'entire Resistance Axis' = 'inseparable part of the ceasefire' (Iran position)
• Trump told NBC: 'very optimistic' about peace deal
• Vance: peace talks 'going to be positive' BUT warned Iran 'don't try to play us'
• Pakistan deployed hundreds of police + paramilitary in Islamabad
• WH Leavitt earlier: Iran's 10-point proposal was 'literally thrown in the garbage by Trump'
• Pakistan FM Dar + France FM Barrot held call on 'serious ceasefire violations' in Lebanon

INDIA'S POSITION
• EAM Jaishankar to visit UAE Apr 11-12
• MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal: 'closely following developments'
• Foreign Secretary Misri in Washington meeting senior US officials
• J&K CM Omar Abdullah urged US to 'exert some control over Israel'
• RBI flagged Hormuz disruption as 'drag on FY27 production'
• Structural shields holding:
  - Only 40% crude via Hormuz (vs EU/Japan 50%+)
  - US 30-day waiver for Russian oil
  - 6-8 weeks fuel stocks
  - Reliance bought 2M Iranian barrels direct (Apr 7)
  - Sea Bird Iranian LPG at Mangalore — first in 7 years
  - 8 of 9 Indian LPG carriers extracted
  - 51 lakh cylinders delivered Mon, ZERO dry-outs
  - 345 Indian fishermen returned
  - Pakistan brokered with India as quiet diplomatic backer

BOTTOM LINE
Day 42 closes with Saturday morning's Islamabad talks now THE single pivot point of the entire war. The picture is fundamentally mixed: Lebanon de-escalation pathway opened (Salam to Washington, State Dept hosting talks, Israeli defense minister claims Hezbollah is 'pleading'); BUT Israel-Hezbollah continued strikes Friday with Beirut death toll exceeding 300, Iran adviser Kharazi died, Hormuz still 95% blocked with only 19 ships in 3 days, Iran's new supreme leader vowing 'decisive victory' and Hormuz 'new phase', AEOI insisting enrichment 'will fail to be limited.'

India's structural shields are holding remarkably well — Sensex above 76,000 despite ₹8,200 Cr FPI outflow, TCS Q4 strong, Brent down 12% on week, rupee stable around 92.40. Morgan Stanley still calls 95,000 Sensex by Dec 2026.

If Saturday talks succeed → Sensex tests 80,000, Brent retreats to $85, Reliance's Iranian crude direct purchases reward Mukesh Ambani.

If Saturday talks fail → Trump's 'Shootin Starts' activates, Brent targets $145, Sensex retests 74,000, full re-escalation.

The weekend will define the entire trajectory of FY27.
